dedupe_keys.name: packaging machine cutting blade degradation over twelve months

description: This dataset is published by inIT and hosted on Kaggle. It records degradation of the cutting assembly in an OCME Vega shrink-wrapper used in food and beverage production lines. The blade cuts plastic film before heat shrinking packages of bottles or cans. The source describes 519 CSV files collected over twelve months, each containing about eight seconds of measurements at 4 ms intervals, with 2048 samples per file. Eight operating modes and several machine speeds are identified. Coverage is this production-machine component; month numbers are relative, not calendar months. The data supports condition monitoring and remaining-useful-life prediction for maintenance windows. The source links related new-versus-worn blade data, which is not assumed to be the same release. CC BY-SA 3.0 terms are stated; reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that sample gaps, replacement events and the full variable schema were not independently checked. No CSV or archive contents were obtained.
